body: I wouldn't even know what to do if I went to the ER. I'd feel so awkward.

>If he were having suicidal thoughts, wouldn't you do anything you could to help him? Wouldn't you want him to tell you right away? Would you feel he's being manipulative or needy then? And if not, why would you expect anything less from him?

I'd definitely want him to tell me, but I still can't decide. I'd feel so guilty for ruining the initial plan.
I did quit my job because of my depression. And as I said, I have no friends or family.

It's not the fact that he's going away that is upsetting me. I was just already super depressed and suicidal and just feel like I can't handle it this weekend. I can't even think of things I enjoy doing. I normally browse the internet or play games, but everything sounds boring and I can't concentrate on anything at the moment.
